title: Choose the Long Weekend SG composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Which layout should the working site carry forward?

options.label: Year Wall
options.thesis: All twelve months stay equally scannable while one floating leave ticket becomes the signature interaction.
options.viewport: A compact control masthead above a four-by-three month wall, with the selected ticket floating over its month.
options.risk: The dense year view demands disciplined type sizing on smaller laptops.

options.label: Operations Rail
options.thesis: A strong left rail carries policy and legend while the selected month expands into a boarding-pass result.
options.viewport: A vertical command rail beside a three-column month field and a wide ticket crossing the selected month.
options.risk: The rail reduces the space available for comparing all twelve months at once.

options.label: Seasonal Bands
options.thesis: Quarter-like bands make cross-month breaks feel like one continuous runway-guidance path.
options.viewport: Three seasonal rows of four month slips with a recommendation ticket suspended between adjacent cards.
options.risk: The extra band labels add structure but slightly more visual ceremony.
